entry_gate: No layout changes or comparisons until current integrated product passes S0; bind the successful head and test merge in VS2_V1_S0.md.
selection: Try A once; B only for measured glyph/clearance failure. At most one correction pass per candidate. No font resizing; no unbounded parameter search. Stop and document if neither satisfies.
composition: Use unchanged safe board budget. Minimum reserves and fit first, GF1 extra actual row capacity second, translation of the complete raster/hint block last. Measure a stable ink/status envelope (including marker/read extremes) without artificial empty slots; translate drawing and hit geometry together. Clamp on tight surfaces. Shift right group with its mounts, labels and hits; reduce only the group shift on tight surfaces if required.

NA01: row pitch <26 times UI; unchanged face and size policy; columns 18 times UI
real 1/11/17/40/100 ink, C1/AA and status union at UI100/125
both axes: markers, all statuses, five complete numbers across every visibility boundary and open interval; monotonic drag, snap, semantic reads; V all hints
NA02: used envelope and safe area, four margins, translation, desired/actual pitch, pre/post-translation fit and reserve recorded
same budget and fit before/after translation, no extra empty slots
centred envelope on generous cases and safe constrained cases; no change on fill/X/status/undo/redo/drag; actual corners/hints after resize/mode
NA04: generous group x decreases and y increases versus bound old image geometry
all controls/mounts/labels within paper and clear of used board and recovery; minimum color hit 44/55px
four sizes, two UI scales, G/V; compact fallback recorded

negative_controls: old left placement rejected on generous case

pictures.before: original hash-bound F01 plus matched baseline captures using archived regular source only in explicit V1 comparison
after: F01 1920 G UI100 full and native clue crop
pictures.retain: targeted native originals only; no default complete gallery; hash all rendered checks and report omitted optional images

validation: all relevant Godot and Python regressions
change-selected CI and ci-required; actual head/base/test-merge
newly downloaded regular Windows EXE pair, PCK, fresh/partial/completed starts, native normal/maximized input/UI/DPI, redo/recovery
